summary: A Google DeepMind researcher notes that OpenAI has joined ElevenLabs in adopting Google's SynthID audio watermarking technology.

practices.reason: Third-party adoption of SynthID audio watermarking could mean integrating a new safeguard/tooling standard across the industry, though the post gives no technical detail on how to integrate it.
practices.quote: Great to see @OpenAI join @ElevenLabs in adopting @Google's SynthID for audio
